p5_b3.ocr: Results are reported in Precision (Prec), Recall (Rec) and F-measure (F1). Unigrams and bigrams with feature source (either title or abstract, TIAB+bigram) are combined with concepts identifiers (+CUI), meta-data (+Meta), noun phrases (+NP), hypernyms (+Taxo), MTI predictions (+mti), MTI components (mti+prc) and all the features (+all). For each column, results significantly better (p>0.05) than the ones obtained with unigram or TIAB+bigram are indicated with *.

p5_b4.ocr: Figure 1 Classification performance per MeSH heading. The figure shows the F-measure for each MeSH heading, when the best combination of features is used for classification (TIAB+bigram+all) and using the best performance ML algorithm (SVM-perf).
